senses.gloss: (cmp. עִילָה, סִיבָּה end) to bring about, to cause.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 44b:9">Snh. 44ᵇ</cite> (play on <cite ref="P00741"><he>עָכָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="Joshua 7:24">Josh. VII, 24</cite>) <he>זמרי … שעי׳ עוונותיהם וכ׳</he> his name was Zimri (<cite ref="I Chronicles 2:6">I Chr. II, 6</cite>), but he was named ʿAkhan (Circle), because he caused the punishment of Israel’s sins.
